# Caveman

Original skill made agents say less. Caveman 2 makes them read less too.
Use `/caveman [lite|full|ultra|off]` to adjust the verbosity of your output.

For full input compression, install the proxy using `npm install -g @caveman-ai/cli && caveman setup --install`.
